CREATE FUNCTION CDN.GIDFirma() RETURNS INT AS BEGIN DECLARE @Sys VARCHAR(20) DECLARE @F1 varchar(10) DECLARE @F2 varchar(10) DECLARE @F3 varchar(10)
SELECT @Sys=SYS_Wartosc FROM CDN.systemcdn WHERE SYS_ID=2
set @F1 = SUBSTRING(@Sys,0,PATINDEX('%.%',@Sys)) set @Sys = SUBSTRING(@Sys,PATINDEX('%.%',@Sys)+1,LEN(@Sys)) set @F2 = SUBSTRING(@Sys,0,PATINDEX('%.%',@Sys)) set @Sys = SUBSTRING(@Sys,PATINDEX('%.%',@Sys)+1,LEN(@Sys)) set @F3 = SUBSTRING(@Sys,0,PATINDEX('%.%',@Sys)) set @Sys = SUBSTRING(@Sys,PATINDEX('%.%',@Sys)+1,LEN(@Sys)) RETURN CAST(@Sys as int)+CAST(@F3 as int)*POWER(2,8)+CAST(@F2 as int)*POWER(2,16) END
